literal: as ruin will not consider the world being impartial in goodness he who abides decline
translation: The world will not consider as ruin the decline of a person who abides in goodness and maintains impartiality.
modern: நடுவுநிலைமையோடு அறத்தில் நிலைத்து நிற்கும் ஒருவருக்கு ஏற்படும் வறுமையை உலகம் ஒரு கேடாகக் கருதாது.
explanation: This couplet explains how society views the material decline of a truly just person. The word 'தாழ்வு' means a lowering of status or wealth, while 'கெடு' means absolute ruin or destruction. The world does not see the poverty of someone who remains impartial and rooted in goodness as a true loss. Instead, their enduring virtue is recognized as their true wealth, making their material decline insignificant.
